{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nath Goordian heirs''' were a group of royal heirs to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nath Goordi]]. Sometime prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] they came to be in trouble and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seek Ryontarr]] was sent to rescue them. He eventually succeeded; however, there was no record of the heirs returning to Nath Goordi and the world went through a war over who would succeed them. Afterwards, rather than returning to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Ryontarr joined the [[Mind Walkers]] on [[Sinkhole Station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
